sections.title: What this module covers
sections.body: Rails interview questions almost always open with the request lifecycle, because it touches every layer: the Rack protocol, the middleware stack, the router, the controller, the model, and the view or serializer. Interviewers use this question to understand whether a candidate can trace a real request end-to-end and explain what runs at each stage. This page covers the full lifecycle in the order it executes, the Rack protocol and why Rails is just a Rack app, the middleware stack and how to add or remove middleware, Zeitwerk autoloading and constant resolution, Rails engines, and the common scenario questions around request debugging — missing templates, 500s from middleware, and slow responses tracing back to a N+1 in the model layer.

sections.title: Key topics and depth markers
sections.body: Topics: mvc-request-lifecycle, rack-middleware, zeitwerk-autoloading, scenario-based. Each topic has dedicated Q&A covering the concept, the comparison, the internal mechanics, and the scenario-based questions interviewers use to test production understanding.

sections.title: How interviewers probe this module
sections.body: Interviewers at Rails-focused companies probe these topics by opening with a definition question, then immediately following up with when would you use X vs Y? and what are the gotchas?. The depth marker is always the trade-off and the failure mode — not just the API surface.
